During the push/pull operations of mitigation assignments,the system
does not enforce any dependency checks related to SoD conflicts,
function definitions, or the existence of associated users. These
mitigation records can be transferred independently of such validations.
When the Mitigation ID is changed in the source system's assignment
records, and these records are pushed to the target system using the
overwrite option, the system treats this as a new mitigation
assignment.As a result, it creates a new entry in the target system
instead of updating the existing one.
